## Review Checklist

<!-- Reviewers: confirm each item before approving. Authors: self-check before requesting review. -->

- [ ] The PR title follows the commit message convention (concise, imperative mood)
- [ ] The change is linked to an existing issue or has a clear rationale
- [ ] Public interfaces, config, or documented behavior updated in this PR
- [ ] New code has tests; existing tests pass locally
- [ ] No new warnings, TODO debt, or debug output introduced
- [ ] The diff is minimal — no unrelated formatting or drive-by changes
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or generated files committed
- [ ] Breaking changes are called out and migration notes added
